notes: Shopify store, reached by direct fetch (no proxy needed). Every PLP server-renders its own total as 'N items' plus 'Showing 1 to N of N items'; each qty below was additionally cross-checked by enumerating /collections/<handle>/products.json and counting unique products - all matched exactly, so the rendered header is confirmed authoritative here. Blu Dot is furniture-led, so the in-scope list is deliberately short. Dropped as mixed roll-ups after inspecting product titles: 'Home Decor' (132 - contains rugs, baskets, coat racks, office accessories), 'Decor + Accessories' living/dining/bedroom (67/66/67 - same, rugs and pillows bundled in), 'Coat Racks + Hooks' (12 - only 5 wall hooks, rest are garment racks, wardrobe systems and standing coat racks), 'Outdoor Accessories' (14 - mixes a rug, watering can, bar cart, seat pads and a fire pit with 3 lanterns and 3 planters), 'Home Organization' (42), 'Storage Baskets' (17), 'Office Accessories' (45), 'Wall Shelving' (10). Dropped 'Trays' (18) as a strict subset of 'Vases, Trays, + Bowls' (39) - all 18 handles appear inside the 39 - to avoid double counting. Excluded per scope: Rugs (13), Pillows + Throws (6), Bedding, all furniture. Sanity checks: Lamps 16 = 10 + 6; Mounted Lighting 20 = 17 + 2 + 1; View All Modern Lighting 36 = 16 + 20.
